## Post 2: "Write from facts. Edit like a human. Check before you publish."
Three habits behind every prompt in the kit:
1. Give the AI real facts
2. Read every draft aloud
3. Run the checklist

Good copy starts with facts you can stand behind. [YOUR GUMROAD LINK]

## Post 3: "Fill the [brackets]. Paste. Done."
Every prompt in The AI Website Copy Kit works the same way: fill the [BRACKETS] with your own details, paste, and review.

Each one ends with a "Fact Guard" so the AI uses only the facts you provide and flags what is missing instead of guessing.

50 prompts. 10 categories. A reusable brief and a quality checklist. [YOUR GUMROAD LINK]

## Posting tips
- Post the three images over a week, not together. Add one preview image from `2-listing-images/` as a fourth post.
- Put the Gumroad link in your bio and in each caption.
- Reply to every comment and question; they tell you what to add to the listing FAQ.
